## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: OpenAI default model IDs (gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.5) have been verified against OpenAI's official model list; if any default ID does not appear in the live model list, defaults are updated; verification result recorded as a story comment
- DD5: model.haiku, model.sonnet, model.opus and their consumers (enrich-file-impact.sh, semantic-conflict-check.py, resolve-model-id.sh, check-model-id-lint.sh, and four model-config tests) are byte-unchanged across Phase 2 extension — verified by git diff returning empty

## Implementation Notes

### Step 1: Verify OpenAI model IDs

Use WebSearch to verify that `gpt-5.4-nano`, `gpt-5.4`, and `gpt-5.5` are valid, currently-available OpenAI model IDs. Search for:
- "OpenAI gpt-5.4-nano model" 
- "OpenAI gpt-5.4 model"
- "OpenAI gpt-5.5 model"
- Or check the OpenAI models endpoint documentation

If any model ID is invalid or has been replaced/renamed:
1. Update the comment in `plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf` (line ~26): `# OpenAI defaults: model.light=<verified-light-id>, model.standard=<verified-standard-id>, model.deep=<verified-deep-id>`
2. Update the Default entries in `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` for:
   - model.light (~line 1309): change `gpt-5.4-nano` to verified ID
   - model.standard (~line 1320): change `gpt-5.4` to verified ID
   - model.deep (~line 1331): change `gpt-5.5` to verified ID

### Step 2: Record verification result as story comment

Record the verification result as a comment on story 8b07-69d1:
```bash
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 8b07-69d1 "MODEL_ID_VERIFICATION: gpt-5.4-nano=<VALID/INVALID>, gpt-5.4=<VALID/INVALID>, gpt-5.5=<VALID/INVALID>. Verified via <source>. Defaults updated: <yes/no>."
```

### Step 3: Verify boundary preservation (DD5)

Run the boundary check and record result. The Phase 2 baseline is the commit that introduced story 2221-b6b2 (P2-S1). Find it:
```bash
git log --oneline | grep -i "2221-b6b2\|P2-S1\|llm-api-call" | head -3
```

Then diff against HEAD:
```bash
BASELINE=$(git log --oneline | grep -i "2221-b6b2\|P2-S1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
git diff "${BASELINE}^"...HEAD -- \
  plugins/dso/scripts/enrich-file-impact.sh \
  plugins/dso/scripts/semantic-conflict-check.py \
  plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-model-id.sh \
  plugins/dso/scripts/check-model-id-lint.sh \
  tests/scripts/test-model-config-integration.sh \
  tests/scripts/test-model-id-lint.sh \
  tests/scripts/test-resolve-model-id.sh \
  tests/scripts/test_semantic_conflict_check.py
```

Expected: empty output. If non-empty, that is a DD5 violation — investigate before closing.

## TDD Requirement

testing_mode: GREEN — unit exemption criterion 3: this task performs external verification via web research and records results. Any config or docs updates are structural (reference comment and Default value entries with no conditional logic). Exemption: "static assets only; verification task with possible structural config/docs updates; no executable behavioral assertion possible."

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED: 0"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] MODEL_ID_VERIFICATION comment recorded on story 8b07-69d1
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8b07-69d1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); any_match=any('MODEL_ID_VERIFICATION' in c.get('body','') for c in d.get('comments',[])); sys.exit(0 if any_match else 1)"
- [ ] If model IDs updated: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md defaults reflect verified IDs
  Verify: grep -E "gpt-[0-9]\.[0-9]" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | head -5
- [ ] Boundary check ran and result is empty (or investigation done)
  Verify: BASELINE=$(git log --oneline | grep -iE "2221-b6b2|llm-api-call" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1) && [ -n "$BASELINE" ] && git diff "${BASELINE}^"...HEAD -- plugins/dso/scripts/enrich-file-impact.sh plugins/dso/scripts/semantic-conflict-check.py plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-model-id.sh plugins/dso/scripts/check-model-id-lint.sh | wc -c | grep -q "^0$"
data.title: Verify OpenAI model IDs, update if invalid, record result + boundary check
